Class AppService

java.lang.Object
com.github.jjbcoding.trellis.service.AppService
public class AppService extends Object
The AppService facilitates Requests, queries of the Node tree, and start and closure. It is intended to be hosted by any dependency injection framework as a singleton. It must be configured through use of the configure(AppServiceConfigurationBuilder) method before any methods can be called. Some methods cannot be called unless there is a running Node tree, which can be launched by a start method and closed by the close method.
See Also:
